item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Weird little theory I had.

What the foundation has of SCP-753 is only its "head"

Normally the tubes on its back would hook up to a ceiling-mounted robotic arm to move it around, and supply it with nutrient for its organic eye. Also, paint tanks would be hooked to said arm allowing it to have a ready supply handy when working. More or less it would look like a half-meter-long, steampunk GLADoS with paint tanks replacing the screens, no personality cores and the "head" the foundation has replacing the one-eyed head in the Portal games.

This idea was inspired by the fact that SCP-753 seems to use its arms both to paint with and walk on. I was wondering how it avoided tipping over when using one arm to paint and thought it might be intended to be mounted from a mechanical arm.
